


```{r kaplanmeier}
# =============================================================================
# KAPLAN-MEIER: PDL1+ vs PDL1- | TTP y OS
# Cohorte HERMION | TFM Gerard
# =============================================================================

library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(labelled)
library(survival)
library(survminer)

# --- 1. Carga y preparación de datos -----------------------------------------

ruta_db <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/data/Rawdata/Base retrospectiva HERMION 6MAIG2026 julia TFM.sav"

db_raw <- read_sav(ruta_db) |> zap_labels()

db <- db_raw |>
  mutate(
    PDL1_grup = factor(PDL1,
                       levels = c(0, 1),
                       labels = c("PDL1−", "PDL1+")),
    TTP_months = as.numeric(TTP_months),
    TTD_months = as.numeric(TTD_months),
    iPE        = as.numeric(iPE),
    Estado_UC  = as.numeric(Estado_UC)
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(PDL1_grup))

cat("N total disponible para KM:", nrow(db), "\n")
cat("Distribución PDL1:\n")
print(table(db$PDL1_grup, useNA = "always"))

# --- 2. Objetos de supervivencia ---------------------------------------------

surv_ttp <- Surv(time  = db$TTP_months,
                 event = db$iPE)

surv_os  <- Surv(time  = db$TTD_months,
                 event = db$Estado_UC)

# --- 3. Ajuste KM ------------------------------------------------------------

km_ttp <- survfit(surv_ttp ~ PDL1_grup, data = db)
km_os  <- survfit(surv_os  ~ PDL1_grup, data = db)

# Log-rank test
lr_ttp <- survdiff(surv_ttp ~ PDL1_grup, data = db)
lr_os  <- survdiff(surv_os  ~ PDL1_grup, data = db)

cat("\n--- Log-rank TTP ---\n"); print(lr_ttp)
cat("\n--- Log-rank OS ---\n");  print(lr_os)

# --- 4. Paleta y estética comunes --------------------------------------------

cols_pdl1 <- c("PDL1−" = "#E05C5C",   # rojo apagado
                "PDL1+" = "#4A90D9")   # azul

km_theme <- theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "top",
    legend.title      = element_blank(),
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 11, color = "grey40"),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey92")
  )

# Función para extraer p-value del log-rank
lr_pval <- function(lr_obj) {
  p <- 1 - pchisq(lr_obj$chisq, df = length(lr_obj$n) - 1)
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "p < 0.001",
         ifelse(p < 0.01, paste0("p = ", round(p, 3)),
                paste0("p = ", round(p, 2))))
}

# --- 5. Plot TTP -------------------------------------------------------------

p_ttp <- ggsurvplot(
  km_ttp,
  data          = db,
  palette       = cols_pdl1,
  conf.int      = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.12,
  pval          = FALSE,          # añadimos manualmente
  risk.table    = TRUE,
  risk.table.height = 0.28,
  risk.table.title  = "Pacientes en riesgo",
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
  xlab          = "Tiempo (meses)",
  ylab          = "Probabilidad de no progresión",
  title         = "Tiempo hasta progresión (TTP)",
  subtitle      = paste0("PDL1+ vs PDL1−  |  Log-rank ", lr_pval(lr_ttp)),
  legend.labs   = c("PDL1−", "PDL1+"),
  ggtheme       = km_theme,
  fontsize      = 4,
  tables.theme  = theme_cleantable()
)

# --- 6. Plot OS --------------------------------------------------------------

p_os <- ggsurvplot(
  km_os,
  data          = db,
  palette       = cols_pdl1,
  conf.int      = TRUE,
  conf.int.alpha = 0.12,
  pval          = FALSE,
  risk.table    = TRUE,
  risk.table.height = 0.28,
  risk.table.title  = "Pacientes en riesgo",
  risk.table.y.text = FALSE,
  xlab          = "Tiempo (meses)",
  ylab          = "Probabilidad de supervivencia global",
  title         = "Supervivencia global (OS)",
  subtitle      = paste0("PDL1+ vs PDL1−  |  Log-rank ", lr_pval(lr_os)),
  legend.labs   = c("PDL1−", "PDL1+"),
  ggtheme       = km_theme,
  fontsize      = 4,
  tables.theme  = theme_cleantable()
)

# --- 7. Guardar figuras ------------------------------------------------------

ruta_out <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/results/clinical_cohort/"

# TTP
png(filename = paste0(ruta_out, "KM_TTP_PDL1.png"),
    width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 300)
print(p_ttp)
dev.off()

# OS
png(filename = paste0(ruta_out, "KM_OS_PDL1.png"),
    width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 300)
print(p_os)
dev.off()

# Panel combinado (opcional)
png(filename = paste0(ruta_out, "KM_TTP_OS_PDL1_panel.png"),
    width = 4800, height = 2000, res = 300)
arrange_ggsurvplots(list(p_ttp, p_os), ncol = 2, nrow = 1)
dev.off()

cat("\nFiguras guardadas en:", ruta_out, "\n")

# --- 8. Resumen medianas de supervivencia ------------------------------------

cat("\n--- Resumen KM TTP ---\n"); print(km_ttp)
cat("\n--- Resumen KM OS ---\n");  print(km_os)
```
